messages:
Claire: quick one — opened a PR to update the Python SDK snippet in auth.md. Need a reviewer + merge window before Friday. Link preview is failing though. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
Diego: sending to docs queue — @Nina can you pick this up? failing check shows `Broken link: /sdk/python#auth` in linkcheck step.
Nina: I can take it. Do we want to merge in today's 4pm slot or wait for tomorrow's quieter window?
Claire: today's 4pm is fine if tests pass. the link is just an anchor mismatch (old `#authentication` -> new `#auth`).
Jamal: heads up — linkcheck has been flaky on main. You can force a rerun with `/ci rerun 789`.
docs-bot: CI rerun requested for PR #789 — queued.
Diego: if Nina picks it, please add yourself as reviewer in the PR and ping me when green. fallback reviewers are @Alex or @Sara if blocked.
Nina: claimed. fixed anchor in auth.md and added a tiny unit test for the snippet. pushed a new commit. @docs-bot can you rerun CI?
docs-bot: CI rerun requested for PR #789 — running.
docs-bot: CI passed ✅ — preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-789--redwood-docs.netlify.app/auth
Claire: LGTM, thanks Nina. @Diego please merge in the 4pm window. Nina, can you add a one-line changelog note about the SDK example tweak?
Nina: done — changelog entry added in the same PR. will hold until Diego merges.
Diego: merging now — :shipit:
